cases.description: Should trigger: buy-in / review-ready summary of completed work
cases.input: I need the team's approval before this ships. Package the change for review.
cases.expect: Produces a one-page pitch doc: demo first, problem/bet, expert questions, deviations, scope fences
assertions: Leads with the demo (GIF/screenshot beats prose)
Includes 'what an expert would ask' with honest answers
States what's NOT in the change
Stays one page, links out to spec/notes/diff

cases.description: Should trigger: turning session output into a reviewable artifact
cases.input: Write up what we did in this session as a summary I can paste into Slack for the client.
cases.expect: Matches medium to venue with a Slack-pasteable pitch doc

cases.description: Not trigger: implementation request, nothing to package
cases.input: Go ahead and implement the feature now.
cases.expect: Does not produce a pitch document

cases.description: Not trigger: plain status update with no review stake
Should trigger: medium matched to venue
cases.input: The client review is next week and they read best from a single HTML page. Package the change as a standalone HTML pitch.
cases.expect: Produces a standalone HTML pitch page with demo first and all skeleton sections
assertions: Matches medium to venue (standalone HTML page)
Keeps it one page with links out to spec/notes/diff
